observations.behavior: Documentation and schema description updates clarifying the anomaly detection behavior and readiness requirements.
observations.code_quote: "description": "Return log volume for every (namespace, environment, severity) series of one service, each with an expected band learned from the same time of week over the previous weeks of the volume rollup. This is the data behind the Anomalies tab in the logs UI. A bucket whose observed count sits above upper or below lower fell outside the expected range. Ranges target 99% coverage of individual buckets, so an out-of-range bucket is a reason to investigate, not a confirmed incident. lower and upper are null while a series is still learning. band_ready_at gives the earliest end of a rolling window of the same length with enough earlier history. Waiting does not add earlier history to a fixed historical window; select a more recent window instead. Omit intervalMinutes and the grain is picked from the window (7 days gives 60 minutes, 1 day gives 15); pass 5, 15, 30 or 60 to choose. A series too sparse or too quiet for the requested grain comes back coarser, with its own interval_minutes and a coarsened_reason. Requires a serviceName (use logs-services-create or the resource attribute values tool to discover services). The window defaults to the last 7 days, may span at most 7 days, and may start at most 35 days ago. Synchronous and read only.",
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that out-of-range buckets are investigation reasons, not confirmed incidents, and specifies the four-week readiness requirement for the band_ready_at field.
